hero.title: I build useful things for real people.
hero.intro: I’m Omar, a full-stack builder and top-ranking STEM scholar from Egypt. I turn ambitious ideas into thoughtful products across web architecture, infrastructure, and human-centered AI.

about.title: Technical depth. Human context.
about.lead: The best technology feels inevitable: quietly powerful, beautifully considered, and made for the person on the other side of the screen.
about.copy: From a factory floor to a funded AI pitch, I’ve learned that good systems are less about showing off complexity and more about earning trust. I bring that mindset to every product, interface, and team I touch.

journey.title: Still becoming.
journey.intro: The environments that shaped how I think, lead, and ship.

items.title: Kafr El-Sheikh STEM High School
items.text: Top-ranking STEM scholar exploring full-stack systems and human-centered AI while preparing for a world-class CS education.

items.title: SPCS · Stanford Pre-Collegiate Studies
items.text: Summer program participant, learning alongside ambitious students and widening my view of what is possible.

items.title: DECI · Digital Egypt Cubs Initiative
items.text: Built a scalable e-commerce capstone and strengthened my foundations in architecture, deployment, and collaboration.

items.title: Factory floor · CNC laser operator
items.text: 40+ hours a week building humility, precision, and grit far away from a comfortable desk.

projects.title: PixelGuard
projects.text: A privacy-first anti-scraping SaaS that injects adversarial noise into images to disrupt AI facial-recognition systems.

projects.title: Hajiz
projects.text: A travel-sync backend connecting real-time aviation APIs with hotel reservations, helping travelers avoid costly no-show penalties.

projects.title: Commerce OS
projects.text: A production-minded e-commerce platform designed as a scalable system, orchestrated with Docker and Kubernetes.
